page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s2.large is an entry-level x86_64 architecture server instance within the ecs.s2 family, utilizing the KVM hypervisor. It is configured with 2 dedicated vCPUs mapped directly to 2 physical cores, providing 1.0 thread per core. The instance includes 4.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 2.0 GB per core.

This server type does not include bundled local storage or integrated GPU hardware, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external network-attached volumes. Additionally, the CPU lacks advanced instruction sets and hardware acceleration features, such as Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX, AVX-512), Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX), cryptography standards (AES, SHA-NI), and virtualization extensions (VMX, SVM).

From a resource density perspective, the ecs.s2.large offers a low-capacity compute profile. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing capabilities without the performance degradation associated with shared-core environments, though the absolute memory and compute limits restrict its application. It is suitable for lightweight workloads such as basic web serving, small utility applications, or simple development environments that do not require specialized CPU instructions or high memory capacity.
